name: Code Quality Gates
description: Fail-closed deterministic code-quality gates, lint rules, and test compliance reporting.
author: Total Recall contributors

tasks: Set up or change a repository's gates

subcommands.name: report
subcommands.description: Read the latest gate report or --review-diagnostics, with --json for machine output. Never starts a check

subcommands.name: run
subcommands.description: Run the selected repository's configured fast or full gates once and persist the report

subcommands.name: snapshot
subcommands.description: Copy the exact source under test (git file lists of this repo and linked plugin repos, secrets refused) to the test node, with a SHA-256 manifest

subcommands.name: gate
subcommands.description: List, add or remove this repository's gates (validated, recorded in the project vault)

subcommands.name: config
subcommands.description: Get, set, validate, check, rebuild or import the repo-layer config

subcommands.name: detect
subcommands.description: Propose gates from the repository (--apply to record them)

subcommands.name: init
subcommands.description: Create the repo-layer config from defaults, detection and prompts

commands.name: code-quality-check
commands.description: Run this repo's gates once and write reports/latest.json (--tier fast|full|remote, --only <id>).

commands.name: code-quality-report
commands.description: Read the latest gate report and whether it is still current.

elements.description: Home: verdict, freshness, coverage, findings and the declared operations for this repository. Data comes from `code-quality report --json`; absent data never renders as passing.

view.description: JSON printed by `total-recall code-quality report --json`. Absent view renders as no data, never as passing.

elements.description: Latest gate report with honest status: revision, coverage, skipped gates, timings, stale/missing/infrastructure errors. Data comes from `code-quality report json`.

view.description: JSON printed by `total-recall code-quality report json`. Absent view renders as no data, never as passing.
